upstream: DigestDef.Algorithm (MD2, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA3-256, SHA3-384, SHA3-512)
evidence: run: sha256Digest('abc') = node:crypto = FIPS 180 known answer ba7816bf...15ad; the only digest/hash export in @spikedpunch/ripstream-core is sha256Digest
note: 1 of 9 algorithms. node:crypto covers md5, sha1, sha2, sha3; MD2 is not in OpenSSL 3 defaults (needs a JS lib).

upstream: DigestDef.Encoding (HEX default, BASE32, BASE64)
evidence: source: sha256Digest returns lowercase hex only; no Encoder abstraction
note: Key suffix rule: hex is bare tk:digest:<ALG>, others append :BASE32/:BASE64.

upstream: CommonsDigester (JCA MessageDigest; MD2..SHA-512; rejects SHA3)
evidence: source: CommonsDigester.checkSupported throws for SHA3-* and points to BouncyCastleDigester; no ripstream class
note: Feeds tk:digest:* keys. Cheap to build on node:crypto streaming hash.

upstream: BouncyCastleDigester (SHA3-256/384/512 via BC)
evidence: source: BC is the only upstream path for SHA3
note: node:crypto createHash('sha3-256') makes this trivial in JS; no BC needed.

upstream: InputStreamDigester (reads the whole stream; digest() and digestSink(); rewinds the TikaInputStream)
evidence: source: InputStreamDigester.java:105-141 reads to EOF, no markLimit, uses enableRewind/rewind
note: Semantics: one pass over all bytes regardless of parser read limits; side effect: sets Content-Length (InputStreamDigester.java:74-79) when blank; honours CacheMemoryBudget from the ParseContext; tis.tryRetainInMemory() for embedded entries.

upstream: CompositeDigester (runs N digesters in sequence, stream rewound between)
evidence: source: CompositeDigester runs each child digest() in turn (stream rewound by each); digestSink() fans every write to all child sinks
note: Part of every multi-algorithm config.

upstream: CommonsDigesterFactory (parse-context key commons-digester-factory; config: digests[{algorithm,encoding}], skipContainerDocumentDigest=false)
evidence: source: factory fields at CommonsDigesterFactory.java:52-53; registry entry packages/core/src/generated/upstream-services.ts:141
note: Config surface to mirror in RipstreamConfig; today no digest option exists.

upstream: BouncyCastleDigesterFactory (bouncy-castle-digester-factory)
note: Same config as commons factory but allows SHA3.

upstream: DigestHelper.maybeDigest + SkipContainerDocumentDigest marker (digest container before parse unless skipContainerDocumentDigest; embedded docs digested at depth>0; depth null/0 = container)
evidence: source: DigestHelper.java:61-121; pipes ParseHandler.java:137-142 digests the container then sets the skip marker so AutoDetectParser does not re-digest
note: Embedded-vs-container semantics are the subtle part for parity of rmeta lists.

upstream: DigestSink / BufferingDigestSink (digest embedded bytes while a parser streams them)
note: Lets OLE2/PST embedded streams be digested without a second read.

upstream: MSEmbeddedStreamTranslator, PSTEmailStreamTranslator, DefaultEmbeddedStreamTranslator (EmbeddedStreamTranslator SPI; NOT language translators)
note: Translates OLE2/PST embedded byte streams to the bytes a user wants (and digests them). Depends on OLE2/PST parsers being present; belongs with the Microsoft/embedded audit.

upstream: tk:digest:<ALG>[:BASE32|:BASE64] metadata keys (TikaCoreProperties.digestProperty)
evidence: run: grep finds 27 tk:digest:* keys (9 algorithms x 3 encodings) in packages/core/src/generated/metadata-schema.ts; no code in packages/*/src writes any
note: Schema-only: keys declared, never produced.

upstream: ParseMode.NO_PARSE = detect + digest only (ParseHandler.detectOnly)
evidence: source: ripstream NO_PARSE returns [{id, bytes}] (pipes/src/index.ts:155); no detection, no digest, no metadata
note: Mode name exists, semantics differ.

upstream: Renderer SPI (Renderer, RenderRequest, RenderResult(s), PageRangeRequest, PageBasedRenderResults, RenderingState, RenderingTracker). Note FastMarkdownTextRenderer matches the grep but is a commonmark NodeRenderer, not a page renderer.
evidence: run: Object.keys(@spikedpunch/ripstream-core) has no export matching /render/i; no Renderer type in packages/*/src
note: No page-render SPI at all; ripstream has no image-out path.

upstream: RenderSettings (dpi, imageType RGB|GRAY, imageFormat PNG|TIFF|JPEG, imageQuality, maxImagePixels, min/max width/height; over() overlay, tightenedTo() ceiling, effectiveDpi, belowMinimum, estimatedPixels)
evidence: source: RenderSettings.java:69 over, :112 tightenedTo, :178 effectiveDpi, :190 belowMinimum, :196 estimatedPixels
note: The ceiling (tightenedTo) is a resource-safety control; relevant to isolation budgets if rendering is ever added.

upstream: PagesConfig / TextPolicy (pages.render, pages.text, pages.ocr, pages.inference, pages.emit)
note: Per-document page scoping; no ripstream analogue.

upstream: PDFBoxRenderer (pdfbox-renderer; temp file per page, renderImageWithDPI, writes tk:rendering:pdfbox-*)
evidence: source: PDFBoxRenderer.java:239-258; ripstream blocks pdf.js native canvas on purpose (block-pdfjs-canvas.ts:14-38) and never renders
note: Page rasterization is the prerequisite for scanned-PDF OCR and thumbnails. JS path would be pdfjs-dist + @napi-rs/canvas, which the isolation child currently refuses to load (address-space cost), so it needs its own budget/decision.

upstream: PDDocumentRenderer (stub interface so PDFParser can hand over a PDDocument instead of a temp file)
note: Reason: PDFBox in-memory object handoff; JVM-only.

upstream: TextOnlyPDFRenderer (PDFRenderer + PageDrawer drawing only text)
note: Reason: PDFBox PageDrawer subclass; pdf.js has no equivalent hook without intercepting the canvas operator list.

upstream: NoTextPDFRenderer (renders without electronic text, so OCR sees only non-text)
note: Reason: PDFBox PageDrawer subclass. Revisit only if a PDF OCR NO_TEXT strategy is wanted.

upstream: VectorGraphicsOnlyPDFRenderer (PDFRenderer + PageDrawer drawing only vector paths)
note: Reason: PDFBox PageDrawer subclass; niche (vector-graphics detection).

upstream: PopplerRenderer (pdftoppm per page; spi=false, opt-in; timeoutMillis 120000, maxScaleTo 4096, 300 dpi gray default)
evidence: source: PopplerRenderer.java:86-97 and ProcessBuilder at :165; registry packages/core/src/generated/upstream-services.ts:271 (spi:false)
note: Reason: external-process (pdftoppm). Precedent exists: ripstream already spawns tesseract as an `unsafe` parser (packages/parser-media/src/ocr.ts).

upstream: POIMetafileRenderer (EMF/WMF to raster via POI HEMF/HWMF; tk:rendering:rendered-by=poi-metafile-renderer)
evidence: source: SUPPORTED_TYPES image/emf, image/wmf; Java2D based
note: Reason: Java2D rasterization of EMF/WMF; no JS EMF/WMF renderer. Used for Word WMF thumbnails.

upstream: CompositeRenderer (media-type -> renderer map, last registration wins; throws when type missing)
note: Needs ren-spi first.

upstream: tk:rendering:* keys (rendered-by, rendering-time-ms, failed-page, pdfbox-rendering-ms, pdfbox-image-writing-ms)
evidence: run: grep finds tk:rendering:* keys declared in packages/core/src/generated/metadata-schema.ts; no producer
note: Schema-only.

upstream: pipes presets thumbnail.json and render-thumbnail.json
note: Preset pages.render config for thumbnails; depends on ren-spi.

upstream: tika-image-processing checks: BlankImageCheck, ByteSizeCheck, MinImageSizeCheck (skip useless images before OCR/inference)
note: Boundary item with the OCR/image audit; pure pixel logic, no native dependency.

upstream: MetadataFilter.filter(List<Metadata>, ParseContext) + MetadataFilterBase (per-Metadata filter(Metadata)); trusted write bracket for reserved tk: keys
evidence: source: ripstream interface is filter(Metadata): Metadata; no list, no context, no trusted writes
note: Cannot express list-level filters (RemoveByMime) or reserved-key writes (GeoPoint, LegacyKeyMigration).

upstream: CompositeMetadataFilter (ordered chain)
note: No chain object anywhere in ripstream.

upstream: DefaultMetadataFilter (ServiceLoader-discovered filters, sorted by class name)
note: Needs a registry/ordering rule if filters become pluggable.

upstream: NoOpFilter
note: Trivial.

upstream: IncludeFieldMetadataFilter (config include[]; exact, case-sensitive name match; removes all other keys)
evidence: run: IncludeExcludeFilter({include:['author']}) on keys Author, author, dc:creator kept [Author, author]; compileGlob uses the 'i' flag (metadata-utils.ts:122-125)
note: Behavior differs: ripstream matches globs case-insensitively, Tika exact/case-sensitive. A literal include could keep keys Tika would drop.

upstream: ExcludeFieldMetadataFilter (config exclude[]; exact name match)
evidence: run: same class and 'i'-flag glob as mf-include
note: Same case-sensitivity divergence; ripstream also accepts globs, Tika does not.

upstream: FieldNameMappingFilter (config mappings{from:to}, excludeUnmapped=true by default)
note: Default drops every unmapped key, easy to get wrong.

upstream: CaptureGroupMetadataFilter (config regex, sourceField, targetField; first group of first match on first value; no-op if no match/no source; overwrites target)
note: Pure string logic.

upstream: ClearByAttachmentTypeMetadataFilter (config types[] validated against EmbeddedResourceType; clears all keys of an embedded doc whose tk embedded-resource-type matches)
note: ripstream rmeta uses X-TIKA:embedded_resource_path/depth (rmeta.ts:49-57); embedded-resource-type enum parity not verified.

upstream: RemoveByMimeMetadataFilter (config mimes[]; removes whole Metadata objects from the list when Content-Type base type matches)
note: List-level filter; needs mf-spi change. Base type = parameters stripped.

upstream: DateNormalizingMetadataFilter (config defaultTimeZone=UTC; rewrites every DATE-typed property to yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'; date-only = midday; partial dates take minimum fields; unparseable left as is)
note: Depends on the property value-type table; ripstream has generated schema valueType (metadata-schema.ts).

upstream: GeoPointMetadataFilter (config geoPointFieldName='location'; writes 'lat,lng' via setTrusted when both present)
note: Needs trusted write for reserved target names.

upstream: LegacyKeyMigrationFilter (direction V4_TO_V3 default | V3_TO_V4; data-driven table of flat renames, drops, egress-only renames, prefix rules incl. digests; unmapped pass through)
evidence: source: LegacyKeyMigrationFilter.java:87-89 config; ripstream rmeta emits X-TIKA:* spellings (rmeta.ts:49-57) while Tika 4.2.0 emits tk:*
note: Key-spelling divergence is the larger parity issue than the filter itself: ripstream output is already V3-style for X-TIKA keys, so there is no 4.x-key output to migrate.

upstream: CharSoupMetadataFilter (tk:content -> tk:detected-language, -confidence = enum name, -confidence-raw = float; no-op when no content)
evidence: source: CharSoupMetadataFilter.java:55-68; schema declares the 3 keys (metadata-schema.ts) but nothing writes them
note: Nothing in ripstream calls a LanguageDetector during a parse; only /language and the CLI `language` command use FrancLanguageDetector.

upstream: OptimaizeMetadataFilter (maxCharsForDetection; same 3 keys)
note: Reason: same output keys as the CharSoup filter, backend-specific; one generic language filter would cover all three.

upstream: OpenNLPMetadataFilter (maxCharsForDetection=10000; same 3 keys)
note: Reason: same as mf-optimaize-lang; OpenNLP backend is an ML model stack.

upstream: TikaEvalMetadataFilter (tika-eval-core: numTokens, numUniqueTokens, numAlphaTokens, numCommonTokens, numUniqueAlphaTokens, lang, langConfidence, oov, languageness)
note: Reason: extraction-QA tooling that needs bundled per-language common-token lists and a JunkDetector model; not on the parse path.

upstream: StandardMetadataLimiter + Factory (write-time: includeFields, excludeFields, maxKeySize, maxFieldSize, maxTotalBytes, maxValuesPerField, includeEmpty; UTF-16 byte budgets; ALWAYS_SET/ADD fields protected)
evidence: run: MetadataWriteLimitFilter({maxValueChars:4}) on 'aaaaaaaaaa' -> 'aaaa'; it is a post-hoc filter over a finished Metadata: per-value chars + values per key only
note: Missing: total budget, key-size cap, UTF-16 byte accounting, write-time enforcement, always-set protection for Content-Type. A hostile parser can still allocate before the filter runs.

upstream: metadataFilters config list (tika-config filter chain)
evidence: run: grep -rn metadataFilters packages/*/src hits only config.ts (declared, validated, frozen at :92); no consumer
note: Accepted and silently ignored, so a user config of filters has no effect.

upstream: LanguageDetector SPI (reset, addText, detectAll -> ranked List<LanguageResult>, hasEnoughText, isReasonablyCertain)
evidence: source: ripstream LanguageDetector is detect(text) -> single result
note: No ranked candidates, no incremental addText, no enough-text signal.

upstream: LanguageResult / LanguageConfidence (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, NONE + rawScore)
evidence: run: ripstream confidence values observed over 43 inputs = {0.9, 0} only (franc path)
note: Franc detector emits constant 0.9 or 0; confidence carries no signal. Oracle /language returns no confidence at all (text/plain).

upstream: CharSoupLanguageDetector (default detector in server; 204 languages; ServiceLoader class-name order picks it first)
evidence: run: 38-input differential, oracle correct 37/38, ripstream (franc, minLength 10) correct 31/38, agree 30/38 (78.9%); long 19/19 agree, short 11/19
note: ripstream returns ISO 639-3 (franc), oracle ISO 639-1. Optional Cld3LanguageDetector exists (cld3.ts:8) but is not used by server or CLI.

upstream: OptimaizeLangDetector (n-gram profiles; superseded by CharSoup as default)
note: Reason: JVM-only library; franc/cld3 fill the same role.

upstream: OpenNLPDetector + ProbingLanguageDetector
note: Reason: OpenNLP JVM ML model stack.

upstream: TextLangDetector (MIT Lincoln Lab text language id)
note: Reason: JVM-only model jar.

upstream: Lingo24LangDetector (vendor cloud API)
note: Reason: vendor cloud API with API key.

upstream: PUT/POST /language (text/plain body; response text/plain ISO 639-1 via toIso1; first 100000 chars only; '' when undetermined)
evidence: run: both endpoints called with 43 inputs; contract differs: oracle text/plain '639-1', ripstream application/json {language(639-3), confidence, isReasonablyCertain}; edge-empty oracle '' vs ripstream 'und'; no 100k sample cap in ripstream (only maxBodyBytes)
note: Clients written for Tika's /language break on ripstream's JSON. Oracle 4.2.0 has no /language/string route (404).

upstream: LanguageHandler / LanguageWriter (SAX/Writer wrappers that detect as content streams)
evidence: source: StreamingLanguageDetector buffers first 20000 chars and re-detects every feed
note: Different shape (re-detect per chunk, prefix cap); not wired into any handler.

upstream: LanguageNames (code/name normalization helper)
note: Low value; ripstream hard-codes none.

upstream: Language detection during a parse (filter writes tk:detected-language*)
evidence: run: no producer of tk:detected-language* in packages/*/src; detectors used only by server /language and CLI `language` (cli/src/main.ts:166-172)
note: Same gap as mf-charsoup-lang from the detector side.

upstream: Translator SPI (translate(text, src, dest), translate(text, dest), isAvailable)
evidence: source: ripstream translate(text, target, source?) is async; no isAvailable
note: Argument order differs (target before source).

upstream: DefaultTranslator (first isAvailable() translator via ServiceLoader)
note: No translator registry; server takes one translator in options.

upstream: EmptyTranslator (returns null, isAvailable=true)
evidence: source: IdentityTranslator returns input text unchanged, Tika EmptyTranslator returns null
note: Semantics differ.

upstream: CachedTranslator (LRU per sourceLang:targetLang)
evidence: source: ReliableTranslator adds retry, timeout and min interval only (translate.ts:129); no cache
note: Cache is the missing part.

note: Config surface differs from Tika's properties-file keys.

evidence: source: RemoteTranslator provider 'microsoft'; unverified: no live provider call made
note: Same as tr-google.

upstream: Lingo24Translator (vendor API)
note: Reason: vendor cloud translation API.

upstream: YandexTranslator (vendor API)
note: Reason: vendor cloud translation API.
